name: Add Deal
description: Adds a new deal. See the Pipedrive API docs for Deals [here](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/Deals#addDeal)

configurable_props.name: title
configurable_props.label: Title
configurable_props.description: Deal title

configurable_props.name: ownerId
configurable_props.label: User ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the user who will be marked as the owner of this deal. If omitted, the authorized user ID will be used.

configurable_props.name: personId
configurable_props.label: Person ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the person this deal will be associated with

configurable_props.name: orgId
configurable_props.label: Organization ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the organization this deal will be associated with

configurable_props.name: pipelineId
configurable_props.label: Pipeline ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the pipeline this activity will be associated with

configurable_props.name: stageId
configurable_props.label: Stage ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the stage this deal will be placed in a pipeline (note that you can't supply the ID of the pipeline as this will be assigned automatically based on `stage_id`). If omitted, the deal will be placed in the first stage of the default pipeline. Get the `stage_id` from [here](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/#!/Stages/get_stages).

configurable_props.name: value
configurable_props.label: Value
configurable_props.description: Value of the deal. If omitted, value will be set to 0.

configurable_props.name: currency
configurable_props.label: Currency
configurable_props.description: Currency of the deal. Accepts a 3-character currency code. If omitted, currency will be set to the default currency of the authorized user.

configurable_props.name: status
configurable_props.label: Status
configurable_props.description: open = Open, won = Won, lost = Lost, deleted = Deleted. If omitted, status will be set to open.

configurable_props.name: probability
configurable_props.label: Probability
configurable_props.description: Deal success probability percentage. Used/shown only when `deal_probability` for the pipeline of the deal is enabled.

configurable_props.name: lostReason
configurable_props.label: Lost Reason
configurable_props.description: Optional message about why the deal was lost (to be used when status=lost)

configurable_props.name: visibleTo
configurable_props.label: Visible To
configurable_props.description: Visibility of the deal. If omitted, visibility will be set to the default visibility setting of this item type for the authorized user.

configurable_props.name: isDeleted
configurable_props.label: Is Deleted
configurable_props.description: Whether the deal is deleted or not

configurable_props.name: isArchived
configurable_props.label: Is Archived
configurable_props.description: Whether the deal is archived or not

configurable_props.name: archiveTime
configurable_props.label: Archive Time
configurable_props.description: The optional date and time of archiving the deal in UTC. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. If omitted and **Is Archived** is `true`, it will be set to the current date and time.

configurable_props.name: closeTime
configurable_props.label: Close Time
configurable_props.description: The date and time of closing the deal. Can only be set if deal status is won or lost. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`

configurable_props.name: wonTime
configurable_props.label: Won Time
configurable_props.description: The date and time of changing the deal status as won. Can only be set if deal status is won. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`

configurable_props.name: lostTime
configurable_props.label: Lost Time
configurable_props.description: The date and time of changing the deal status as lost. Can only be set if deal status is lost. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`

configurable_props.name: expectedCloseDate
configurable_props.label: Expected Close Date
configurable_props.description: The expected close date of the deal. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`

configurable_props.name: labelIds
configurable_props.label: Label IDs
configurable_props.description: The IDs of labels assigned to the deal

configurable_props.name: customFields
configurable_props.label: Custom Fields
configurable_props.description: An object where each key represents a custom field. All custom fields are referenced as randomly generated 40-character hashes

configurable_props.name: note
configurable_props.label: Note
configurable_props.description: The content of a note to be attached to the deal. The note will be created after the deal is successfully added.
